negative_reviews.author: Sep Nowrouz
negative_reviews.text: Arrived for our first time to try Maki & Ramen… initially didn't feel welcome. Was sat down, menu wasn't explained to us, waited nearly 20 minutes for someone to actually acknowledge us. Felt ignored the whole time. It wasn't busy. Decided to leave as we couldn't even get the staff attention. We were looking forward to trying the food, but I find service equally as important.

negative_reviews.author: Aris Alcantara
negative_reviews.text: They promised that if we don't get our food within 30 minutes it will be free. Our takoyaki didn't come even before we had our bill. That's a total of more than 1 hour of wait. Nobody even apologised or acknowledged that the service/food was late. No urgency at all! Specially that we are celebrating a special occasion today. So disappointing.
